A correct result would trace one continuous traversable path from the bottom-right entrance to the building; these strokes run across grass, stop in the lower maze and never reach the destination, a major omission. Knowledge: the supplied explanation is blank; the score uses the mandatory coupling, not an absent explanation. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality assessed alone: ✔ coherent illustrated building, trees and figures, ✔ consistent flat cartoon lighting and textures, ✔ clean maze and red strokes without visible generation artifacts; softness does not obscure the scene.

The expected result is calcium chloride pellets added to the ice water with the specified five-minute state represented; discrete pellets are not shown and the substantial ice remains unchanged, so most of the requested modification is poorly implemented.
